patch_list: Disable Play Store redirect for Punge
Stops Punge from opening the Play Store on launch when the app was sideloaded or patched instead of installed from Play.
Stops Firebase Remote Config fetches and Play Measurement so feature flags cannot be changed after install.
Stops AdMob banners and interstitials from loading or showing.
Unlocks Punge's paid feature gates by making RevenueCat report an active entitlement.
